skill.summary: 本地扩展技能目录 - 聚合所有 OpenClaw 本地技能，支持列表查询、描述提取、缓存加速、差异对比、自动更新技能清单

latestVersion.changelog:
Skill-list v1.0.0 – Major update: now supports fast, smart, and flexible listing of local OpenClaw skills.

- Replaced old skill-list script with a new one featuring directory scanning, auto description extraction, and smart caching (Pickle).
- Automatic cache refresh only on skill add/remove; much faster repeated queries.
- Supports multiple output details: simple, half, full, including SKILL.md content.
- Adds export options: JSON and Markdown for easy external use and sharing.
- Command-line interface redesigned with new arguments for force-refresh, output level, format export, and debug/help.
- Documentation expanded with exact usage, workflow, and integration examples.
